info.title: Haggles API
info.description: Haggles facilitator protocol API (`/v1/*`), portal API (`/portal/v1/*`), and PayPal webhooks (SPEC.md section 5).

get.description: Returns 200 OK whenever the API process is up (SPEC.md section 5.1).
Verifies PostgreSQL connectivity and that all required migrations have been applied (SPEC.md sections 5.1 and 9.3).
Returns active and recently retired Ed25519 public keys used to verify payment tokens and receipts (SPEC.md section 4.6).

post.description: Validates a 402 challenge, enforces the agent key's spending policy, places a hold on the buyer wallet, and issues a short-lived Ed25519 payment token (SPEC.md section 5.1).

get.description: Returns a payment for the owning agent key or seller key. Sellers receive a pseudonymous agent_ref and never buyer identity (SPEC.md sections 5.1 and 8.4).

post.description: Verifies the payment token, atomically transitions the payment from authorized to captured, credits the seller net of platform fee, and returns a signed receipt (SPEC.md section 5.1).
Refunds a captured payment within 24 hours, returning the gross amount (including platform fee) to the buyer wallet's available balance (SPEC.md sections 5.1, 6.3, 7.4).

get.summary: Read buyer wallet balance and policy allowance
get.description: Returns available and held USD balance plus remaining per-call, daily, and monthly policy allowances for the authenticated agent key (SPEC.md sections 5.1 and 10.2).

get.summary: Start Log in with PayPal authorization flow
get.description: Generates a cryptographic OAuth2 state cookie and redirects (or returns the authorize URL) for Log in with PayPal (SPEC.md sections 5.2 and 8.3).

get.summary: Complete Log in with PayPal authorization callback
get.description: Verifies the OAuth2 state cookie, exchanges the authorization code with PayPal, fetches userinfo (`payer_id`, primary confirmed email, `verified_account`), and sets `hg_session` and `hg_csrf` cookies (SPEC.md sections 5.2 and 8.3).

post.description: Invalidates the current `hg_session` token and clears session/CSRF cookies (SPEC.md sections 5.2 and 8.3).

get.summary: Read current authenticated account profile and roles
get.description: Returns the authenticated account profile, enabled roles (`is_buyer`, `is_seller`), wallet ID, seller ID, and environment mode (SPEC.md sections 5.2 and 11.6).

patch.summary: Update current account profile and Buyer/Seller roles
patch.description: Updates `display_name`, `is_buyer`, and `is_seller` roles, provisioning wallet/seller records as needed and enforcing non-zero balance role guards (SPEC.md sections 5.2, 11.3, 11.6).

get.description: Returns available and held balance, in-flight hold count, today's spend, smallest daily key cap, 30-day spend, and recent payments (SPEC.md sections 5.2 and 11.4).
Returns daily spend totals over the requested number of UTC days (default 30, SPEC.md sections 5.2 and 11.4).
Lists all agent keys belonging to the authenticated buyer's wallet along with today's spend per key (SPEC.md sections 5.2 and 11.4).

post.description: Issues a new `hgk_<env>_...` agent key with spending policy caps. Returns the full secret key once at creation (SPEC.md sections 5.2, 5.3, 8.1, 11.4).

get.description: Returns a single agent key owned by the authenticated buyer (`404` if owned by another tenant, SPEC.md sections 5.2 and 8.4).

patch.summary: Update a buyer agent key policy
patch.description: Updates an agent key's name and spending policy fields (`404` if owned by another tenant, SPEC.md sections 5.2 and 8.4).

post.description: Immediately revokes an agent key so subsequent authorization requests fail with `401 key_revoked` (SPEC.md sections 5.2, 8.4, 8.8).

get.summary: List buyer payments with filters and cursor pagination
get.description: Lists payments for the authenticated buyer wallet filtered by key, seller, status, and date range (SPEC.md sections 5.2 and 11.4).
Returns detailed timeline and receipt for a single payment owned by the authenticated buyer (`404` if foreign, SPEC.md sections 5.2 and 8.4).
Lists PayPal top-up orders for the authenticated buyer wallet with cursor pagination (SPEC.md sections 5.2, 7.1, 11.4).

post.description: Validates top-up and max wallet balance limits, creates a `topups` record, and creates a PayPal Checkout Order v2 with `PayPal-Request-Id = top_<ULID>` (SPEC.md sections 5.2 and 7.1 step 1).

post.summary: Capture an approved PayPal top-up order
post.description: Captures the PayPal Checkout Order and credits the buyer wallet ONLY when PayPal confirms `COMPLETED` status (SPEC.md sections 5.2 and 7.1 steps 3-4).

get.description: Returns pending, processing, and paid-out balances, 24h call count, 30d net revenue, top endpoints, and recent calls (SPEC.md sections 5.2 and 11.5).
Returns daily net revenue and call counts over the requested number of UTC days (default 30, SPEC.md sections 5.2 and 11.5).
Lists endpoints discovered on capture along with 30-day call count and net revenue (SPEC.md sections 2.1 D7, 5.2, 11.5).

patch.description: Updates `display_name`, `description`, or `status` for a seller endpoint (`404` if owned by another tenant, SPEC.md sections 5.2, 8.4, 11.5).

get.description: Lists all seller API keys (`hgs_<env>_...`) belonging to the authenticated seller (SPEC.md sections 5.2 and 11.5).

post.description: Issues a new `hgs_<env>_...` seller API key (max 2 active keys per seller) and returns the full secret key once (SPEC.md sections 5.2, 6.1, 11.5).
Immediately revokes a seller API key (`404` if owned by another tenant, SPEC.md sections 5.2 and 8.4).

get.summary: List seller calls with pseudonymous agent_ref
get.description: Lists calls (payments) to the authenticated seller's endpoints with pseudonymous `agent_ref`, gross amount, platform fee, and seller net (SPEC.md sections 5.2, 8.4, 11.5).
Lists payouts for the authenticated seller in reverse chronological order (SPEC.md sections 5.2, 7.2, 11.5).

post.description: Initiates an on-demand payout to the seller's PayPal `payer_id` (max 1 request per hour, minimum $1.00 pending balance, floored to whole cents, SPEC.md sections 5.2 and 7.2).

post.summary: Issue a sandbox test agent key for seller setup
post.description: Issues a sandbox-only agent key restricted to this seller (`allowed_sellers`) and capped at $0.50/day so the seller can test their first paid call without funding a separate buyer wallet (SPEC.md sections 5.2 and 11.5 step 4).

post.summary: Receive and verify PayPal webhook notifications
post.description: Verifies the PayPal webhook signature using the raw request body bytes, deduplicates by `paypal_event_id`, and reconciles top-up captures and seller payout items by re-fetching from PayPal (SPEC.md sections 5.2, 7.1, 7.2, 8.5).
